name: Sean Carson
bio:
An aspiring men's physique competitor and fitness coach with over 6 years of serious time under the bar.



Fitness isn't something I stumbled into. It's something I've built, rep by rep, over years of learning what actually works not just in theory, but on my own body. I've spent that time dialing in everything from programming and nutrition to the mental side of staying consistent when motivation fades.
story:
I’m Sean Carson and I help people get real results.

I created AMP'D UP because I was tired of seeing everyday people misled by fads, gimmicks, and cookie cutter programs that just don’t work. Fitness doesn’t have to be complicated but it does require consistency, clarity, and accountability. That’s where I come in.

As a coach, I blend no BS fitness strategy with real world mindset support. Whether you’re just getting started or ready to level up, I’m here to make sure you don’t just work out you train with purpose.

What I’m About

Sustainable Results - No crash diets. No burnout. We build habits that stick.

Busy Person Friendly - I train professionals, parents, entrepreneurs. People with real schedules and real goals.

Energy, Discipline, and Confidence - This isn’t just about lifting more. It’s about showing up for your life stronger, sharper, and more in control.

name: Benny Apple
bio: I'm Benny, owner of BappleFit Coaching LLC and an Exercise Science graduate with over 6 years of experience in fitness, 4 years in the training field. I help busy people build muscle, lose fat, and create sustainable habits through personalized training, nutrition, and accountability. My goal is simple: help you get results without fitness taking over your life.
story:
My journey into fitness started from my own passion for training and quickly evolved into a career built around helping others transform both physically and mentally. Over the last 6+ years, I've gained experience in personal training, nutrition coaching, strength and conditioning, fitness sales, and business operations, while earning my degree in Exercise Science.

Throughout my career, I've worked with a wide range of clients, from teenagers learning the basics of training to adults over 60 looking to improve their health and quality of life. I've helped clients lose over 100 pounds, build confidence in the gym, improve athletic performance, and develop sustainable habits that fit their lifestyles. My coaching philosophy is centered around creating realistic, personalized plans that clients can actually stick to long-term rather than relying on restrictive diets or unsustainable workout programs.

Today, BappleFit Coaching LLC provides both online and in-person coaching with a focus on strength training, body recomposition, fat loss, muscle growth, and accountability. My mission is to give every client the structure, education, and support they need to build a stronger body, healthier lifestyle, and greater confidence both inside and outside the gym.

name: Rogelio Perez
bio: At 14 I realized I needed to grow, I was a scrawny kid. I started at home with limited equipment. Learned to master my bodyweight. Once I transitioned to a gym I mastered the weights.
story:
At 14 years old, I lost an arm wrestling competition and got made fun of for how skinny my arms were. I had already been doing random ab workouts at home, but losing that competition really sparked my drive to become bigger and stronger.

When I got home, I tried doing push-ups and couldn't even do six proper reps. That's when I discovered calisthenics on YouTube. I became obsessed with learning how to train and progress at home with limited equipment. I would load backpacks with books, use broomsticks with water jugs as makeshift barbells, and do whatever I could to improve with what I had.

When the pandemic hit, I moved from Florida to Texas for a while since school became virtual and I hadn't seen family in a long time. Luckily, the gym my cousins trained at stayed open, and that's where I started lifting weights seriously. We would spend late nights in the gym constantly pushing ourselves, and that's where my powerlifting journey began. I became focused on improving the "big three" lifts: squat, bench, and deadlift.

Eventually, I moved back to Florida and lost access to a gym again, so I had to continue progressing from home. By then, I had bought gymnastics rings, which completely changed my training and opened up far more exercise options. Around this time, people at school started noticing my physique, and I would occasionally train at local gyms using guest passes with friends.

Because of my calisthenics background, I had already learned how important joint health and movement quality were. While many people around me dealt with shoulder, elbow, and lower back pain from poor training habits, I became interested in learning how to avoid and fix those issues.

Over time, my focus shifted away from pure powerlifting and more toward hypertrophy and building muscle. I wanted to learn everything I could about bodybuilding and muscle growth. The problem was that a lot of mainstream fitness advice either wasn't effective or was designed around people using performance-enhancing drugs. I trained incredibly hard, pushed myself constantly, ate as much as I could â sometimes even eating three school lunches a day â yet I still hit frustrating plateaus.

That frustration led me deeper into researching training, recovery, nutrition, and the science of muscle growth. I studied different training philosophies, from old-school bodybuilding methods to modern evidence-based approaches, and eventually realized that even many popular "science-based" fitness influencers were missing important pieces of the puzzle.

After years of trial and error, I finally developed a much deeper understanding of effective training, recovery, nutrition, and long-term progression.

Now at 20 years old, my goal is to help others avoid the same mistakes, confusion, and frustration I went through. I know what it feels like to work hard without seeing results, and I want to help people train smarter so their effort actually pays off.

name: Cortez Clinton
diet: Flexible / IIFYM, High protein, Carnivore, Keto, Vegan, Whole foods, Intermittent fasting
bio: I was an overweight, lonely kid who hated what he saw in the mirror. My dad, who was handicapped, introduced me to fitness when I was 9 years old, and by 14 I was committed to changing my life. Today, I help people build the confidence, discipline, and strength that fitness gave me.
story:
I didn’t get into fitness because it was trendy—I got into it because I needed it.

Growing up, I was overweight, insecure, and lonely. I hated how I looked and how I felt. My dad, who was handicapped, introduced me to fitness when I was 9 years old. Even with the challenges he faced, he taught me the value of discipline, resilience, and showing up when things are hard.

At 14, I decided I was done feeling sorry for myself and started taking training seriously. Fitness became more than exercise—it became the thing that changed my confidence, my mindset, and ultimately the direction of my life.

Today, I coach people who feel stuck, overwhelmed, or frustrated with where they are. My coaching isn’t about quick fixes or crash diets. It’s about building sustainable habits, creating accountability, and helping people become stronger physically and mentally. I want my clients to realize what I learned years ago: your circumstances don’t define you, and you’re capable of far more than you think.

name: Ian Anthony
diet: Flexible / IIFYM, High protein, Intermittent fasting
bio: I help the average individual build lean muscle, lose body fat, and get stronger without spending hours in the gym. I focus on real results through consistency, smart training, and sustainable habits.
story: I am a dedicated fitness professional with a lifelong foundation in athletics and human performance. My background as a Division I collegiate soccer player sparked a passion for training that continued to grow throughout my academic and professional journey. After a successful decade working in forensic science, I transitioned fully into the fitness industry to pursue my true calling—helping individuals unlock their potential. I bring a results-driven, client-focused approach built on high standards, strong communication, and genuine enthusiasm for each client’s progress. I enjoy training men and women, young and old, and a fresh face or seasoned vet in the gym.

name: Zachary Johnson
bio: I’m Zack! 👋 I was a skinny kid my whole life, when my wife was pregnant with our first I gain 50 pounds and decided I would not be that person for my kids. I have been training for 6 years now. I feel and look the best that I ever have!
story:
I became a coach because I know firsthand how much your health affects every part of your life.

Fitness isn’t just about losing weight or building muscle. It’s about having the energy to play with your kids, the confidence to feel good in your own skin, and the discipline to become the person you want to be.

My mission is simple: help busy people and families look their best, feel their best, and build healthy habits that last for life.

I’ve spent years learning what works, and now I’m passionate about helping others achieve results without extreme diets or spending hours in the gym.

If I can help someone become healthier, more confident, and more present for the people they love, then I’m doing exactly what I set out to do.
